## 2) Likely breakages if `combat_test_v2` files are deleted and “default” is pointed at v1

- **Broken `extends`:** `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd` extends `res://combat/scripts/combat_test_v2.gd`. Removing `combat_test_v2.gd` without changing this breaks any loader that resolves `combat_test.gd`.
- **`combat_test.tscn` script mismatch:** It currently attaches `combat_test_v2.gd`. Removing v2 requires repointing the scene’s script (and ensuring the scene tree matches the script — see below).
- **Scene tree vs script (high impact):** `combat_test_v1.gd` depends on `%` nodes defined in the v1 scene (e.g. `%BankrollLabel`, `%BetMinusButton`, `%PremiumMeterCircle`, `%BudgetLabel`). `combat_test_v2.gd` builds most of its shell in `_build_combat_frame()` and uses different `%` nodes (no bet/bankroll/budget circle in the same way). **Changing only the script on `combat_test.tscn` from v2 to v1 without replacing the scene contents will fail at runtime** (missing unique-named nodes).
- **Feature/code-only differences:** v2 listens to `combat.matched_symbols_resolved`; v1 max seed in UI differs (`12345` vs `2147483647`). Defaulting to v1 changes playtest/UI behavior independent of deleting v2.
- **Orphan scripts if v2 removed:** Only `AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test_v2.gd` preloads `chip_bar_segment.gd` and `matched_log_tile.gd`. No other `.gd`/`.tscn`/`.tres` references turned up for those paths. Deleting v2 leaves those helpers unused unless referenced elsewhere later.
- **Editor `.uid` files:** Removing `combat_test_v2.gd` / related scenes may leave stale `.uid` entries in the filesystem (worth cleaning when implementing; not searched exhaustively here).
- **Docs/history:** `README_COMBAT_TEST_VERSIONS.md`, `README.md`, `AI_CHANGELOG.md`, and QA notes still describe “v2 default”; smoke test still loads `combat_test.tscn`.

---

## 3) `combat_test_v1.tscn` — parser / format risks

Path: `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test_v1.tscn`

- **`[gd_scene]` line:** Uses `uid="uid://combat_test_v1_scene"` and **no `load_steps`** (contrast default `combat_test.tscn`). Usually Godot recomputes on save; minor inconsistency only.
- **`ext_resource` paths:** Present for `combat_test_v1.gd`, `combat_root.tscn`, `terminal_theme.tres`, `premium_meter_circle.gd`, `scanline_overlay.gdshader` — targets exist under `AXEL/axel_project/combat/`.
- **`unique_id=` on nodes:** Matches other AXEL `.tscn` files (e.g. Main Menu, School Exterior); unlikely to be v1-specific breakage.
- **Multiline `text = "` on SUPER FS buttons:** Physical newlines inside quotes (same pattern as `combat_test.tscn` / v2 shell). Low risk if Godot emitted it; tooling that expects single-line `.tscn` strings might complain.
- **No obvious malformed `ExtResource`/SubResource id drift** in the portion inspected (shader subresource binds `ExtResource("5_scanline")` with id `5_scanline` declared).

---

## 4) Checklists and suggested implementation order

### Must update (to make v1 the default entry and retire v2)
1. **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`** — Either replace contents with v1-compatible tree **or** make this scene match what `combat_test_v1.gd` expects (not script-only flip).
2. **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`** — Point alias at `combat_test_v1.gd`; adjust header comment once v2 is gone.
3. **`AXEL/axel_project/test/scene_smoke_check.gd`** — Still valid path if default `combat_test.tscn` becomes v1; re-run smoke after scene swap.
4. **Remove or archive v2 artifacts** (when ready):  
   `combat/combat_test_v2.tscn`, `combat/scripts/combat_test_v2.gd`, and paired `.uid` if present.

### Decide explicitly (cleanup / orphans)
5. **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/chip_bar_segment.gd`** (+ `.uid`)
6. **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/matched_log_tile.gd`** (+ `.uid`)  
   Remove if v2-only; keep if you still want the chip-bar prototype.

### Strongly recommended (docs / correctness)
7. **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/README.md`**
8. **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/README_COMBAT_TEST_VERSIONS.md`** (or fold into README if versioning is retired)
9. **`AXEL/axel_project/plans/combat/AXEL_combat_implementation.md`** — Fix wrong `res://combat/test/combat_test.tscn` note to match actual path.
10. **`AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md`** — New entry describing default → v1 and v2 removal (per project governance).

### Optional
11. **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md`**
12. **`AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md`**
13. **`combat_test_v1.gd`** — Optionally rename debug breadcrumbs from `"combat_test.gd:..."` to reflect real filename (behavior-neutral).

### Suggested ordering
1. Align **`combat_test.tscn` scene tree with v1** (copy/merge from `combat_test_v1.tscn` or consolidate to one canonical scene).  
2. Point **`combat_test.gd`** at **`combat_test_v1.gd`**.  
3. Run **`scene_smoke_check`** path (manual or automated) against **F6 ** `combat_test.tscn`.  
4. Delete **v2** scene/script (and **`chip_bar_segment` / `matched_log_tile`** if unused).  
5. Refresh **README / version README / implementation doc / changelog**; optionally **verification + QA log**.
